name: Niobium
note: Brazil supplies ~90% of world output (CBMM, CMOC).
uses: High-strength low-alloy steel for pipelines, cars and construction; superalloys for jet engines; superconducting magnets.
why_it_matters: Brazil supplies most of the world's niobium from a handful of mines, so one country's policy and one company's contracts set the market for both the United States and China.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
